name: Delletto
tagline: Swipe through your photos and decide what stays.
description: Delletto turns clearing out your camera roll into a quick swipe deck. Each photo gets one decision: keep it, favorite it, think it over or delete it. Nothing is gone for good until you confirm.

platforms.note: No public download yet. iPhone apps need the App Store or TestFlight.

features.title: Swipe left to delete
features.text: The photo moves to Trash and is deleted for good after 30 days, and only after you confirm.

features.title: Swipe right to keep
features.text: The photo is filed in Saved.

features.title: Swipe down if unsure
features.text: It waits in Second Thoughts until you decide.

features.title: Find duplicates
features.text: Finds exact copies and look-alikes on your phone. Compare two side by side, swipe them, or let the app pick the worse ones for you to check.

features.title: Undo and Cancel All
features.text: Bring back the last photo, or start over with every photo back in the deck.

features.title: Photo details
features.text: See when and where a photo was taken, plus camera and file details.

setup: Download the file on your phone and open it.
If Android asks, allow your browser to install apps.
Open Delletto and give it access to your photos.
limits: This is a test build, so Android will warn that it comes from an unknown source.
